topics.purpose: Define audit that required human docs, indexes, UML/tree/graph and other declared projections can represent the accepted canonical graph without losing required semantic information.

semantics.source_rule: Accepted/candidate canonical graph snapshot is exact.
semantics.coverage_rule: Contracts/topics/relations/ownership/operations expected in each projection are enumerated.
semantics.authority_rule: Projection incompleteness never changes source semantics.
semantics.repair_rule: Repair regenerates/extends projection, not canonical source from projection.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.
